- Goal: low-latency inference for NovaBank customer-facing flows (sub-200ms p95)
- Data sensitivity: regulated payments PII; you mentioned SOC 2 + additional audit requirements
- Current priority: evaluate a pilot for one product line in Q4 (target start Nov)

Next steps I promised:
1) High-level VPC/private deployment overview (attached) — includes network model, control plane, and KMS options.
2) Security artifacts: SOC 2 summary + evidence bundle (attached).
3) Ballpark pricing & timeline for a Dedicated / Private deployment (will scope once we confirm topology).

Jonas (cc) is our Solutions lead — he can help scope the VPC connectivity (site-to-site VPN vs. AWS Transit, peering, or direct connect) and outline the typical lead times and prerequisites.

Can you let us know: 1) if Private/VPC is the right track for NovaBank, and 2) who on your side should receive the security pack (security or infrastructure)?

If helpful, propose a quick 30-min follow-up next week to run through the attached and map requirements.

Hi Alex —

Following Marissa's note and jumping in to offer some technical context. If NovaBank is leaning toward Private/VPC, here are a few items we'll need to scope and a rough timeline:

Required from your side:
- Network topology (VPC IDs, preferred connectivity: VPN / Direct Connect / Peering)
- Expected qps and typical sequence lengths (to size Dedicated capacity)
- KMS/HSM requirements and key provisioning flow
- Any IP allowlist or egress control requirements

Typical timeline (ballpark):
- Prep & network config: 1-2 weeks
- Private control plane onboarding & auth: 1 week
- Provision Dedicated capacity and validation: 2-3 weeks

If helpful I can share a short checklist (network ACLs, TLS certs, SAML config) and a proposal template for pricing. Also happy to join a call that includes your security/infra folks.

Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
